sentences.text: Cyclobenzaprine , sold under the brand name Flexeril among others , is a muscle relaxer medication used to relieve skeletal muscle spasms and associated pain in acute musculoskeletal conditions .	muscle relaxer	muscle relaxer	skeletal muscle	skeletal muscle	acute	Acute (medicine)
It is the best-studied drug for this application .
It has also been used off-label for fibromyalgia treatment .	off-label	Off-label use	fibromyalgia	fibromyalgia
